Order and pay

Choose a package, describe your drawing and pay by QR code with ShopeePay, Touch ’n Go or PayPal. When you place an order, a payment window opens where you choose your method and scan its QR code. After you pay, your order waits for my approval, then your delivery time appears.

Extra options (18+)

Adult characters only. The extra price is added to your total.

Questions and policies

How many revisions do I get?

Two free revisions at the sketch stage.

What does Waiting for approval mean?

I am checking your payment. When I approve it, the status changes to Approved and your delivery time is shown.

How do I receive my art?

When your order is Delivered, a Download button appears in My orders.

Is paying by QR safe?

Check that the account name in your payment app matches this page, pay the exact total, then attach your receipt to your order. I never change payment details by message and never ask for your banking password, PIN or OTP.

What is your refund policy?

If I cannot deliver your order, you get a full refund. Once I have started drawing, refunds are decided case by case, so please message me early.

Can I use the art commercially?

You may post it online with credit. For commercial use, please ask me first.

How is my information used?

Your name, email and references are only used to make your order. They are not sold or shared.

Can an order be rejected?

I can decline requests that are fake, abusive or break my content rules. If you already paid for an order I declined, contact me with your order number and I will refund you.

Who can order adult (18+) art?

Adult commissions are for ages 18 and over only. I do not accept any sexual content involving minors.
